content: Following configurations in Puduppully, we set word embedding and LSTM decoder hidden size as 600. The decoder's layer was set to be 2. Input feeding BIBREF5 was also used for decoder. We applied dropout at a rate 0.3. For training, we used Adagrad BIBREF8 optimizer with learning rate of 0.15, truncated BPTT (block length 100), batch size of 5 and learning rate decay of 0.97. For inferring, we set beam size as 5. We also set the history windows size as 3 from {3,5,7} based on the results. Code of our model can be found at https://github.com/ernestgong/data2text-three-dimensions/.
